title: ADDRESS TWA and ADDRESS TCTUA: a TWA sized by TWASIZE is shared by the programs of one task, TWASIZE(0) gives X'FF000000', a TCTUA (TYPETERM USERAREALEN) outlives the task

scenarios.summary: TRANSACTION TWASIZE(32): the caller stamps the TWA through ADDRESS TWA, the LINKed callee (no COMMAREA) reads the stamp and writes a reply through its own ADDRESS TWA
TRANSACTION TWASIZE(0): ADDRESS TWA gives the null value X'FF000000'
TYPETERM USERAREALEN(16): a stamp written through ADDRESS TCTUA in one task is read by the next task on the terminal
